name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx reverse proxy with SSL termination and multi-site virtual host management, including host-based firewall hardening (UFW), SSH hardening, fail2ban configuration, and kernel-level sysctl security hardening.

name: cache
description: Dual in-memory caching layer that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same host, with Redis configured on port 6379 with password authentication.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Full-stack Python web application deployment that installs the Python 3 toolchain, clones the FastAPI application from GitHub, provisions a PostgreSQL database and user, and registers a systemd service running uvicorn on port 8000.
